svg.aria-label: Two-screen retro boot header for Michał Czyż. Screen one: EncoreBIOS posts an Encode E35 Cerebrum eight-core processor, counts memory to 32768K, detects the ENCORE-KERNEL and RUST-TOOLS drives, loads encoreldr; the encore operating system splash by encore-industries appears, its lowercase wordmark striped in the classic six-colour rainbow; mike logs in and runs tree on his after-hours directory: rust tools ah, ltx, okiro and Server-Manager; kernels encore, LeafOS and TriOS; self-hosted infrastructure on Rocky Linux and Fedora with Docker and his dotfiles; JavaScript projects loom and james plus QNT by day; AI projects granula, anima and nlp-platform; archived work lyra, ti and ascii; and five university publications from 2024 to 2025. Screen two: the session continues with whoami, then the contents of now.txt, then a machine-translation command whose output renders three approaches side by side — IBM Model 1 alignment arcs crossing between good, morning and dzień, dobry; a Seq2Seq encoder collapsing into a hidden state and a decoder unrolling; and an LLM token stream with an attention fan converging on the predicted token — all three finishing with the Polish translation.
svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

g.text: 7 directories · 89 private repos waiting to ship
